create.name: Shai Tubali
create.bio:
Shai Tubali is an Israeli-born philosopher, author and teacher of contemplative practice whose Insight Timer profile gives his base as Berlin. He started out as a journalist and fiction writer, and in his early twenties a long stretch of self-inquiry brought what he describes as a direct meeting with a consciousness larger than the personal self. That turning point shaped everything after it. Through his thirties he built structured methods for exploring awareness, among them the Expansion Method, and wrote a run of books on the chakras, the heart and the subtle body, including 7 Day Chakras for Llewellyn.

Later he went back to university, completing a doctorate in philosophy at Leeds on Jiddu Krishnamurti and the old tradition of transformative dialogue, and he is now researching human capacities in an age of artificial intelligence at UCL. He also writes essays for Big Think. His teaching, gathered under the name The Human Practice, mixes philosophy, guided meditation and psychological reflection, and he is wary of the guru model, asking students to find their own footing instead. He leads silent retreats drawing on Rumi, Mahamudra, the Upanishads and the Gospels, usually open online as well as in person, and his YouTube channel holds hundreds of short talks and guided meditations in English.

books.title: 7 Day Chakras: Daily Energy Work to Balance Your Life
books.author: Shai Tubali
books.description: A week-long scheme that gives each day to one chakra, with meditations, affirmations, journal prompts and visualisations for that centre. It also looks at how the seven centres work together and how to weave short energy practices into ordinary routines.

courses.title: The Call of Love: Walking with Rumi into the House of God
courses.description: A five-night winter retreat over New Year at the NEOS centre near Montemor-o-Novo in Portugal, also streamed live for online participants. Shai leads periods of silence, meditation and talks on Rumi and the Sufi view of the heart, with recordings kept on his online campus for two years.
courses.price: €420 EUR online (early bird retreat fee); on site with full board €1,060 EUR (double room) or €1,570 EUR (single room)

free_resources.title: Becoming Love
free_resources.description: A thirteen-minute guided meditation on opening into warmth and love as a felt state. Free on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Opening the Crown Chakra
free_resources.description: A half-hour guided practice that settles attention at the top of the head and widens it into open awareness. Free on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Inner Smile Meditation
free_resources.description: A short audio meditation in English, free to play on his retreat site, in which a gentle smile is turned inwards and spread through the body.

free_resources.title: 21-Days Challenge: End the Mind Chatter
free_resources.description: A free series of daily videos on YouTube, one for each of twenty-one days, with brief teachings and exercises for loosening identification with restless thinking.
